answer: In each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and commits a Semaphore identity to the zero-knowledge tree. It evaluates an epoch polynomial under an RLN rate limit; each message carries a proof that its nullifier is unique. Duplicate messages expose two polynomial shares tied to the same identity, allowing Shamir reconstruction of the private key and immediate, verifiable collateral slashing. Dune, summit, and ledge checkpoints label independent epochs without creating additional identities.
